description: Peat Dredge rebuild after wave5c went 0/8 (toothed breach-maw 8/8 — crocodile/anglerfish prior with the lantern hung inside the mouth as a lure; 'glowing from within' was the hook; profile poses stood it up on theropod legs). Fixes: tallow-light prefix; headless back-arch language with both ends underwater; membrane is a sealed dome with a dull sheen, never glowing from within; anglerfish/mouth/legs negatives. Fresh seeds.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, one warm tallow light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

subjects.prompt: a Peat Dredge, the broad headless humped back of a wide low creature breaching the surface of a black bog at a three-quarter angle, both ends of its body still below the dark water so only the smooth arch of compacted dark peat-flesh shows, a cracked translucent amber tallow membrane stretched flat over a sealed dome low on the hump with a dull amber sheen and slow beading drips, a swallowed yellow-brown fen-bone jaw fragment jutting sideways from the dorsal crest, a torn furrow of churned peat trailing behind it, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, bone ash, a single creature, dark misty background

a Peat Dredge barely surfaced, only a low smooth hump of dark compacted peat-flesh showing above still black bog water with both ends underwater, the cracked amber tallow membrane stretched over its sealed dome carrying a dull waxy sheen, a stained fen-bone jaw fragment jutting from the crest, ripples and torn floating peat ringing the hump, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, bone ash, a single creature, pale misty background

a Peat Dredge passing through the frame in full profile, a long broad headless arch of dark compacted peat-flesh curving up out of the black bog and back down into it like a hill moving through water, the cracked translucent amber tallow membrane dome on the near flank beading slow amber drips, the swallowed yellow-brown fen-bone jaw fragment on its dorsal crest, a long torn furrow of churned peat stretching out behind, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, bone ash, a single creature, dark misty background

a Peat Dredge mostly submerged and moving away at a three-quarter rear angle, the top of its broad headless peat-flesh arch cutting through still black water, wet peat sliding off the smooth hump, the fen-bone jaw fragment on the crest silhouetted against pale fog, a wide torn wake of churned peat and broken reeds spreading behind it, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, bone ash, a single creature, pale misty background
